about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the haunting world of Kemskaya Volost.
Relive the frostbitten nights, perilous journeys, and eerie mysteries of The Book of Outcasts through its complete original soundtrack. From the desolate snows of Conussia to the sweltering jungles of distant lands, each track carries the echoes of forgotten empires, whispered secrets, and the relentless march of winter.

This carefully crafted score blends dark fantasy orchestration with atmospheric ambient soundscapes, accompanying you through dungeons, village hearths, and encounters with the undying Outcasts. Whether you’re reminiscing about your adventures or simply seeking an evocative listening experience, this soundtrack offers a journey through cold winds, crackling fires, and the shadowed edges of a broken world.

FEATURES

  • 40+ tracks from the game for standalone listening

  • A mix of orchestral, ambient, and dark folk motifs

  • Perfect for writing, world-building, or revisiting the game’s chilling atmosphere
